infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Poplur needs camera access so you can record location-based posts.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Poplur needs microphone access to record videos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Poplur needs photo library access so you can choose media to post.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Poplur needs your location to show nearby posts on the map.
